description: Use this when someone wants a logo, business branding, a brand identity or a complete brand kit for a business, and no Webba design has been chosen yet. Shows up to six existing logo designs matched to what the business does, or general ones when nothing fits, with its name on them and numbered. Each result has a state to pass to the other tools; once the person chooses, get_download gives them two ways to get it: the logo only, or the brand kit with the logo. Names can be up to 22 characters. Do not use this to suggest business names, make photos or illustrations that aren't logos, edit a logo the person already has, check trademarks, or give general design advice.

business_description.description: What the business does, in the person's words, such as 'delivery company' or 'dog grooming salon'.

business_name.description: The business name, up to 22 characters.

colour.description: A colour the person asked for, such as 'orange'.

tagline.description: A tagline only if the person gave one.

name: find_designs
title: Find logo designs
